steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Given circumstances: the facts of the play — time, place, situation, relationships. An actor must know these before they can act truthfully.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Magic if: 'What would I do if I were in this situation?' — helps the actor find truthful reactions, not fake 'acting'.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Emotion memory: recalling a personal emotional experience to fuel a scene's emotional truth — not reliving, but using the memory.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Units and objectives: breaking a scene into beats (units), each with a specific objective — gives structure and purpose to every moment.

steps.body: Always use Stanislavski's exact terms — 'given circumstances', not 'background info' Show HOW you would apply each technique, not just what it means Naturalism questions need you to link technique to truthful performance Comparing practitioners is a common question — know the key differences
